$description: Ectomatter's design tokens: every gutter, corner, type size, part size, shadow and color the app draws with, in the Design Tokens Community Group's format. The build writes them out for the window (as Slint globals) and for what Ectomatter lays out in Rust (as Rust constants), so the two never disagree. A new design takes these; a value none of them fits is added here first, with what it is for, and then every place that needs it uses it. docs/design-system.md says how the parts are built from them.

space.$description: The app's spacing, every layout's, on a 4 px base (Fluent 2's).

margin.$description: A page's margin, round what it holds, its bar's too; also the gap between cards in a grid (the Library's covers).

gap.$description: Between boxes, side by side or one above another, and between a stage and the boxes under it.

stage.$description: The gutter round a device on its stage, across (Space.margin above and below it): the keyboard's, from its approved page.

section.$description: Between a section's box and the next section's heading; in a box, from one group's last setting to the next group's heading (a rule Space.pad under the setting).

label.$description: From a section's heading down to its box; from a setting's name down to its control.

pad.$description: A box's padding: from its edges to its title and what it holds, and under the last of it; between a form's label column and its controls; between two settings stacked in a box, or a stacked form's fields; between a box's two columns.

row.$description: Above and below the rule between two rows of a form; under a group's heading in small capitals, to its first setting; above a note on a whole group of settings.

inline.$description: Between controls side by side: a bar's buttons, a row of buttons, a field and its button.

tight.$description: Between things that belong together: a name and the line under it, a control and its note, a slider and the words at its ends.

list.$description: Between the rows of a list down a side.

radius.$description: Corners, by the size of what they round. Something round (a dot, a pill) takes half its height instead.

window.$description: The window's own corners, while it isn't maximized.

box.$description: A box, a card, a device's stage, a dialog.

panel.$description: A panel over a box or inside one: a menu, the color picker, a floating bar, a tile in a grid (an effect, a screen page), a well in a box, the rail's items.

control.$description: A button, a field, a drop-down, a row in a list or a menu, a swatch. A part set close inside another (4 px or less) follows its curve instead: the outer corner less the inset.

small.$description: A quiet button, a chip, a tag, a tooltip, a choice in a switch (whose ground is this and Part.inset, so the two curves follow each other).

tiny.$description: A checkbox, a badge, a mark inside a control.

font.$description: The typefaces, their weights, and the type ramp: each size named for what it sets.

ui.$description: Every word the app's own pages set.

mono.$description: Commands as they are typed (Custom Scripts).

medium.$description: Buttons, tabs, names that lead a row.

strong.$description: Titles and box headings; a primary button's words.

display.$description: A reading shown large (the weather now).

title.$description: A page's name in its bar; a dialog's title; a window's own page title (the lab's).

lead.$description: A bar's way back (the Library's); the first line of an empty page.

tab.$description: A page's tabs in its bar; the name leading a form's row (a device's, a plugin's).

name.$description: A name that leads a row or a card; an empty box's first line.

text.$description: Labels, names in lists and menus, a box's title (strong).

control.$description: A button's words, what is typed in a field, a list's rows.

note.$description: A hint, a note, a status, a quiet link.

caption.$description: The line under a name; a detail.

small.$description: A heading in capitals, a callout's name, a tag.

caps-tracking.$description: A heading in capitals' letter-spacing (Font.small, strong, in the quiet gray): PROFILES, a group's name in a box, a heading inside a plugin's section, ON THIS PAGE.

title-tracking.$description: A page's name's letter-spacing, in its bar or an editor's header.

display-tracking.$description: A reading shown large's letter-spacing (the weather now).

line.$description: A line of words' height, by what the words are, wherever Rust lays words out: words sit at the middle of their line, so two lines of a kind are always a line apart, and words beside a control of the same height sit level with it.

text.$description: Words read on a row: a setting's name, a value, a fact, a row's name, a status.

note.$description: A note, a caption, a credit; a section's heading over its box.

small.$description: A group's heading in small capitals inside a box; the words at a slider's ends.

size.$description: The sizes parts share across pages, so a part is the same size wherever it is.

bar.$description: A page's bar: its name, its tabs, its buttons.

head.$description: A page's head under its bar: the hint line (12 down, 36 tall) and 6 under it to what comes next.

box-head.$description: A box's head: its title's band (Space.pad's worth less 2 above it, 22 tall), where what the box holds starts.

column.$description: A page's first column: the Profiles box, a side list (the mouse's lights).

library.$description: The Key library's box, at its least (a row of boxes grows a box from its least).

detail.$description: A key's or a button's job box, at its least: as narrow as its kinds' switch still reads whole (the mouse's eight, Sensitivity the longest), so the row of boxes holds it beside the Key library with the rail open in a 1440 window.

game.$description: Game mode's box, at its least.

effects.$description: The effects' box (three tiles across), at its least.

settings.$description: A box of settings laid out from a description (an effect's, a mouse's section) and a slider's box, at their least.

places.$description: The box of where and when an effect plays, at its least.

sidebar.$description: An editor window's list down its left side.

form.$description: The widest a form's column grows (Settings, a device's Settings, a game's page).

edit-screen.$description: A device's screen in the Screen Editor, across: the Z10's 20 by 4 cells, 39 square.

win-button.$description: A window button in the title bar (minimize, maximize, close), across.

seg-tall.$description: A tall switch, a glyph over each choice's words (a key's kinds of job).

rail-open.$description: The rail down the window's left, opened into its blade with each place's name, across.

rail-shut.$description: The rail shut: a column of its glyphs, across.

layout-card.$description: A screen layout's card in Layouts at its least, across: two to a row while each has this.

layout-card-h.$description: A screen layout's card in Layouts, tall: its screen's picture and its words beside it.

chooser.$description: A chooser of a few short choices (a script's time limit), across; a chooser named for its choice is as wide as its words, up to this.

dialog.$description: A form's dialog across: the scene form, adding a game or an app.

ask.$description: A dialog that asks one thing (whether to go ahead, or a name for something), across.

control.$description: A field's, a drop-down's and a switch's height.

row.$description: A row in a list down a side (the profiles, the macros, the screen layouts): a name and the line under it.

quiet.$description: A quiet control's height: a link in a box (a LinkButton), a checkbox and its words.

pill.$description: A pill's height: a value in a small well, a tag.

swatch.$description: A color's dot (the room round it, ringed while its picker is open), and a color's button with its code.

slider.$description: A slider's height: its track at the middle, its knob's reach.

chip.$description: A chip's height: a zone to light, an area.

tab.$description: A tab over a box, whose open one runs on into the box.

compact.$description: A control on a bar or a toolbar: a quiet button with words (a TextButton), a chooser at a panel's head.

hero.$description: A game's picture across the top of its page in the Library.

cover-name.$description: A cover's name under it in the Library, two lines at most, Space.inline under the cover.

find.$description: A find box across, beside a page's hint (the Library's).

pick-row.$description: A row to pick in a list in a dialog (an app that's been in front): its small icon and its name.

pick-icon.$description: An app's small icon in a row to pick.

empty.$description: What an empty area says, at its widest.

app-icon.$description: An app's icon in its row in the Library's Apps.

app.$description: A row in the Library's Apps: an app's icon, its name and what changes for it.

reset.$description: A row's reset dot on a game's page: the place to press round it, at the left of the row's label.

sensor.$description: A sensor's chip, and the line of them: its checkbox, its names, its reading.

tile.$description: An effect's tile, wherever effects are chosen: its picture and its name.

scene-tile.$description: An effect's tile across, in the scene form (four in a row with room to spare).

preview.$description: A scene's preview across the desk, at the top of the scene form.

round.$description: The playlist's round-again glyph, after its strip and before Pause.

block-chip.$description: A block to add to a screen layout, on the Screen Editor's bar.

foot.$description: The lab's foot: what is on the device now, what was last done, Revert and Save, on a line under a rule.

picker.$description: The color picker across, hung from the swatch that opened it.

menu.$description: A menu at its narrowest. A menu is as wide as its rows need, from this to menu-most, and never narrower than the field it drops from (the Game Configurator spec's menus); its notes wrap inside it.

menu-most.$description: A menu at its widest; a longer row's words are cut short.

menu-search.$description: A menu with a search box: always this wide, so it keeps its width while the search narrows its rows.

rename.$description: A name renamed in place in an editor's bar, across.

menu-head.$description: A heading inside a menu, over the rows it heads.

menu-rule.$description: A line between a menu's groups, with its room.

rail.$description: An item on the rail down the window's left: a square with its glyph.

list-head.$description: A heading over a list's rows: PROFILES, a group in the Key library (which opens and shuts).

strip.$description: A run of colors' height, as an effect blends them.

hint.$description: The hint line under a page's bar, and the controls on it (the screen's default backlight), each at its middle.

dot.$description: A status dot (a device's connection, a setting's state).

spinner.$description: A spinner, while something is read or loads, across.

part.$description: A part's own measurements that a page laid out in Rust works its widths out from (a button as wide as its words): the part draws with them and Rust measures with them, so the two agree.

quiet-pad.$description: A quiet button's (a link's, a text button's) room each side of what it says.

button-pad.$description: A button's room each side of its words.

glyph.$description: A glyph before a button's words.

glyph-gap.$description: From a glyph to the words after it.

title-top.$description: From a box's top to its title's line (Line.title tall); what sits beside the title, at the box's top right, sits level with it.

pill-pad.$description: A pill's room each side of its words.

chip-pad.$description: A chip's (an area's) room each side of its words.

chip-tick.$description: What a chosen chip's tick adds to its width: the tick (12) and its gap (5), less the 3 the chip's left side gives up for it.

choice-pad.$description: A switch's button's room each side of its words, where the buttons are as wide as their words (so a lab's three keycaps share its column).

inset.$description: A piece set close inside another: from a switch's ground to its buttons, all round; from a sensor's chip to the field its name is typed in.

choice-gap.$description: Between what a switch's button holds: its icon, its words, its chevron.

check-gap.$description: From a checkbox to its words.

field-pad.$description: A field's and a dropdown's room before what it holds (a glyph, or the words), and a dropdown's after its chevron.

tab-pad.$description: A tab's room each side of its name (a tab over a box: the Screen tab's, the Sensor Feed's).

sensor-pad.$description: A sensor's chip's room at each end, and between its words: its checkbox, its name, its driver's name, its reading, its pencil.

scroll-in.$description: A scrollbar's place: in from the right edge of what it scrolls (a box, a page, a list).

chain-in.$description: A macro's chain, in from its canvas's edges (macros.rs lays the chain's steps from it).

menu-pad.$description: A menu's rows, its search box and its Back, in from its edges and apart.

menu-in.$description: A menu row's words, in from the row's ends.

ring-out.$description: A ring round what's dropped onto (a screen layout carried over the screen), this far out from its edge.

press.$description: How far a pressed control's words and glyph sink, so the press is felt.

chevron.$description: A chevron, and the small glyphs a control carries: a drop-down's, a fold's, a strip's, a play button's.

primary.$description: How much taller and wider a primary button stands than its neighbors, so it leads its row.

tab-in.$description: A device bar's tab: its words in from its ends (a folder tab's are Part.tab-pad).

drag.$description: How far a press moves before it carries what it pressed (a card, a turn, a block, a step), rather than selecting it: Windows' drag threshold.

menu-aside.$description: What a menu's row says on its right (a playlist's profiles, a count), at most this share of the menu's width, so it never crowds out the row's own name.

menu-number.$description: A number typed on a menu's row (a pad's width, a turn's time), across: room for four digits.

fold-in.$description: What a fold opens, set in under its words: the fold's chevron and the gaps round it.

tile-inset.$description: An effect tile's picture, in from the tile's sides and top.

tile-pic.$description: An effect tile's picture's height (Rust draws the picture at the tile's width less its insets).

span-gap.$description: Between the devices' parts of a scene's preview, each device's name under its part.

swatch-words.$description: From a color's button's left edge to its code: its dot, 20 across and 4 in, and the gap after it.

stroke.$description: How thick a line is, by what it draws (Fluent 2's and Primer's border widths, 1 and 2, with the half step the app's chosen edges have).

line.$description: A line: an edge, a rule, a box's border, a grid's line.

chosen.$description: The edge of what's chosen on a picture: a device on Home, a key, a block's cells on their way in.

ring.$description: A ring round what's carried, dropped onto or selected to change, and the playhead.

shadow.$description: How far a surface lifts off the page, in three steps.

lift.$description: A little: a cover, a tooltip.

float.$description: A menu, the color picker, a popover, a floating bar, something carried; a cover under the pointer.

ink.$description: The window's shades, darkest to lightest: the frame (title bar, rail), the page, the boxes on it. Wells (fields, tracks, the profiles' panel) sit darker than the box they are in. Every control has four states, each a step apart and none the color behind it: at rest, under the pointer (in a well, on a box), chosen, chosen under the pointer. Settable while the app runs, for a color mock (ECTOMATTER_INK).

well.$description: A well, darker than the box it is in: a field, a track, the Profiles box.

stage.$description: The stage every device is drawn on, its page's: lighter than the well, as a black device needs (the mouse's approved mock's).

hover-well.$description: Under the pointer, in a well.

hover-box.$description: Under the pointer, on a box; also a raised surface (a menu, a tooltip, a chip).

pop.$description: A popover over a box (a strip's times, a tag's words).

line.$description: A rule: between rows, under a bar.

edge.$description: An outline at rest (a field, a checkbox), a list's scrollbar, the lines drawn to a device's buttons.

edge-hover.$description: An outline under the pointer or typed in.

seam.$description: A raised surface's outline (a tooltip, a panel), a small cap's edge.

tint.$description: A light wash under the pointer, over a raised surface (a menu's row).

scrim.$description: Over the window behind a dialog.

preview.$description: The ground under an effect's small moving picture.

bright.$description: Words and marks at full strength.

placeholder.$description: What an empty field asks for.

warn.$description: Changed from the factory's; a warning.

bad.$description: What went wrong; a choice that deletes.

danger.$description: A button that deletes, at rest.

danger-hover.$description: A button that deletes, under the pointer.

close.$description: The window's close button under the pointer.

white.$description: Words and marks on a strong fill (a button that deletes, a lit swatch); a primary button under the pointer. A part's light washes and hairlines are white at an opacity of the part's own.

black.$description: A part's dark washes (a press, a picture's film), at an opacity of the part's own.

media.$description: A media key's mark in a macro.

off.$description: What isn't known, isn't there, or can't be changed now: a status dot; a control held off, and its words.

shade1.$description: The shades the pages used before they had names for their parts.

track.$description: A slider's line where its run hasn't reached; the lab's reset arrow while there's nothing to put back.

brand.$description: Ecto green, the family's own color: a slider's run, where the slider sets no light's color (one that does runs in that light's).
